title: kbjob.py opa-config --print prints the OPA configuration and service unit that pull both bundles from coord, and writes nothing
goal: kbjob.py opa-config --print --url URL --token-file PATH --key-env NAME prints an OPA configuration (one service at URL with bearer token_path PATH, the bundles kbjobs and kbjobs-overrides with polling and persist: true, signing keyid kbjobs, the key read from ${NAME} by OPA's environment substitution) and a systemd unit running opa run --server with it; no file is written, and the token's and the key's text never appear in the output

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); h=os.path.join(d,"home"); os.mkdir(h); tf=os.path.join(d,"tok"); open(tf,"w").write("tok-placeholder"); os.chmod(tf,0o600)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py","opa-config","--print","--url","https://kb.corp.example.com","--token-file",tf,"--key-env","KB_BUNDLE_KEY"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env=dict(os.environ,HOME=h,KB_BUNDLE_KEY="bundle-key-placeholder"))
o=r.stdout
assert r.returncode==0 and "kbjobs-overrides" in o and "persist: true" in o and "${KB_BUNDLE_KEY}" in o and "opa run --server" in o, o
assert "tok-placeholder" not in o and "bundle-key-placeholder" not in o and os.listdir(h)==[], o

clauses.clause: kbjob.py opa-config --print --url URL --token-file PATH --key-env NAME prints an OPA configuration (one service at URL with bearer token_path PATH, the bundles kbjobs and kbjobs-overrides with polling and persist: true, signing keyid kbjobs, the key read from ${NAME} by OPA's environment substitution) and a systemd unit running opa run --server with it
the token's and the key's text never appear in the output

notes: Research 2026-11-08: OPA bundle manifest roots, resource default bundles/<name>, Etag/304, bearer token_path, ${NAME} substitution only under opa run and only for defined variables, persistence_directory default $PWD/.opa, and test discovery by the test_ prefix are in kb public/agents/policy-as-code.md (QK-operations-placement-stories-need-opa-bundles).
